name: md-render
description: Rich markdown in Claude Code terminal replies: tinted headings, highlighted code, callouts, grid tables, math, mermaid diagrams and images, after render-markdown.nvim

enabled.title: Custom markdown rendering
enabled.description: Draw assistant replies with md-render instead of the built-in renderer

icons.title: Icon set
icons.description: nerd: Nerd Font glyphs; unicode: plain symbols for terminals without a Nerd Font

headings.title: Heading style
headings.description: full: tinted bar across the width; block: tint behind the title only; plain: coloured text

headingBorders.title: Heading border lines
headingBorders.description: Half-block lines above and below each heading's tint

codeBlocks.title: Code block style
codeBlocks.description: full: tinted block across the width; block: tint sized to the code; box: rounded border; plain: code only

codeBorders.title: Code block border lines
codeBorders.description: Half-block lines above and below a tinted code block

tables.title: Table style
tables.description: full: bordered grid; normal: grid without the top and bottom lines; compact: columns and a header rule only

tableBorders.title: Table borders
tableBorders.description: Border characters of a grid table

links.title: Links
links.description: clickable: https links open on click, URL hidden; url: always show the URL after the label

math.title: Math
math.description: unicode: $...$ and $$...$$ converted to Unicode, display math laid out in two dimensions; raw: TeX as written

images.title: Images
images.description: local: draw image files on this machine; remote: also download https images a reply names (a prompt injection can use this to leak data); off: labels only

mermaid.title: Mermaid
mermaid.description: ascii: mermaid blocks drawn as diagrams by mermaid-ascii (flowchart, sequence, ER); code: shown as code

mermaidCommand.title: mermaid-ascii command
mermaidCommand.description: Name on PATH or full path of the mermaid-ascii binary that draws mermaid blocks

indent.title: Indent sections
indent.description: Shift each section right by its heading level, as org-indent-mode does
